01 / about

I'm a full stack developer with four years at Aeon Media, building and modernising digital publishing platforms. My work spans backend architecture, web interfaces, cloud infrastructure and production AI features. I enjoy understanding a problem, making clear technical choices and carrying the work through to production.

Before software development, I worked in IT support and network deployment. I hold a Bachelor of Biomedical Science from Monash University and have also supported coding students as a teaching assistant.

I'm based in Osaka, hold JLPT N2, and am studying for N1 in December 2026. I'm open to mid-level and senior developer roles that let me continue living in Osaka, including remote work within Japan.

Away from the screen: running, hiking, bouldering and exploring Kansai.
